title: Making Decisions
summary: if and else choose what runs, using comparisons that give 1 (true) or 0 (false). Combine conditions with &&, || and !, which stop as soon as the answer is known. bool comes from stdbool.h. switch picks among whole-number cases - remember break - and the ternary operator chooses between two values.

cards.a:
1

Comparisons give 1 for true and 0 for false.

cards.q: Why does if (x = 5) always run its body?
cards.a:
It assigns 5 to x, and 5 counts as true

Use == to compare. The compiler warns about this with -Wall.

cards.q: In count != 0 && sum / count > 2, what happens when count is 0?
cards.a:
The division never runs, because && stops at the first false

Short-circuit evaluation.

cards.q: What happens if a case in a switch has no break?
cards.a:
Execution falls through into the next case's code

Sometimes intended, often a bug.
